prompt:
A professional 8-frame sprite WALK CYCLE for a side scrolling 2D action game. One character throughout: youthful male chibi dark-fantasy fighter, 3 heads tall, wavy medium brown hair, red eyes, warm light peach skin, fitted black long coat with silver shoulder studs, black trousers, belt with silver chain at hip, heavy dark steel claw-shaped gauntlets and armored greaves with tiny deep-red energy seams. No other weapon. Transparent background. Crisp detailed pixel-style game art. Same proportions/head size in every frame, no blur. Full body in every frame.

2 rows of 4 drawings, read top row then bottom row. STRICT SIDE VIEW LOOKING LEFT, ONE EYE, both shoulders stacked. He walks normally at a calm pace. BOTH ARMS SWING LOOSELY AND FULLY IN OPPOSITION TO THE LEGS. Hands low near thighs, not guard. Low knees and short steps, never a military march. Feet barely clear ground. Stationary root to make an in-place walk cycle. SAME GROUND LINE per row and consistent head level. Deliberately show alternating legs with different overlap:
A left/near LEG heel touches in front, right/far LEG behind on toe; LEFT/NEAR ARM BACK to the RIGHT.
B left foot supports, right foot swings past rear ankle.
C left leg supports upright, right foot passes ahead of ankle; arms nearly vertical.
D right foot approaches forward contact, left heel rolls off; near arm approaching forward-left swing.
E right/far LEG heel touches in FRONT LEFT, left/near LEG is BEHIND to the RIGHT; LEFT/NEAR ARM FORWARD to the LEFT. Obvious opposite pose to A, NOT same leg forward.
F right supports, left foot swings past rear ankle.
G right supports upright, left foot passes ahead of ankle; arms vertical.
H left foot approaches forward contact, right heel rolls off; near arm returns back-right for A.
One normal low natural gait with real support-foot exchange, not eight variants of the same pose. No text, ground, panels or labels. Clear gutters around 8 separate full figures.
note: Independent full-figure gait study after reference-based attempts retained the same leading leg.
